findings.title: Direct EncryptionClient.init({ strategy }) callers silently fall back to the default auto credentials
findings.label: valid
findings.note: init() now accepts and forwards only config.authStrategy (index.ts:130,166) while the strategy alias is resolved only in Encryption(), so direct init({strategy}) callers of the exported EncryptionClient silently lose their strategy; init is @internal, which limits but does not remove the risk.

findings.title: Test-only deprecation-latch reset exported from public entry points
findings.label: trivial
findings.note: Exporting the test-only latch reset from public subpaths is accurate but immaterial to release risk; it affects only log-noise state.
